about: San Francisco Bay Area Craigslist: search listings by keyword, category, area, price, distance and other filters through Craigslist's JSON search API, look up postings by id, and get category counts and search suggestions.

commands.summary: Search SF Bay Area Craigslist listings by keyword, category, area/subarea/city, price range, zip+distance, sort and category-specific filters. Returns the first batch of compact results plus decode ta

params.name: cat
params.description: Category abbreviation, e.g. sss (all for sale), bia (bicycles), apa (apartments), cta (cars+trucks), sof (software jobs). Use get-category-counts to discover more.

params.name: searchPath
params.description: Location scope: area/sfbay (whole Bay Area), subarea/<abbr> where abbr is sfc, eby, sby, pen, nby or scz, or city/<slug>, e.g. city/oakland-ca

params.name: postal
params.description: ZIP code to search around (use with radius)

params.name: radius
params.description: Distance in miles from the postal ZIP code

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: date (newest), rel (relevance), priceasc, pricedsc, dist (needs postal)

params.name: min_bedrooms
params.description: Minimum bedrooms (housing categories such as apa)

params.name: auto_make_model
params.description: Car make/model filter for cta, e.g. 'toyota tacoma' (see suggest-make-model)

params.name: userpostingid
params.description: Posting id to find more ads by the same seller

commands.summary: Fetch the next batch of results for a search already run with search-listings (the site has no page 2; it loads more batches as you scroll).

params.name: batch
params.description: Batch spec '0-<offset>-1080-6-0-<ts1>-<ts2>'. Raise the offset by 1080 for each batch and keep the other parts as the site sent them.

params.name: cacheId
params.description: cacheId returned by the search-listings response for this search

commands.summary: Look up full posting records (title, price, location, neighborhood, images, seo slug, posted date) by posting id. This is how the site loads the favorites list.
Count matching listings per category for a Craigslist search URL. Useful to pick a category abbreviation (cat) for a query.
Autocomplete search keywords for the SF Bay Area, optionally within one category.

params.name: cat
params.description: Category abbreviation to scope suggestions, e.g. cta

commands.summary: Guess which category abbreviations (cat) best match a keyword query in the SF Bay Area.
Autocomplete car make/model names for the auto_make_model filter of search-listings (cars+trucks).
